props.text: Name a connection this gateway already has, or fill in the second row and this page will make one. Only the NAME is remembered, and it is kept outside the project - so importing a new version of the demo never overwrites what this gateway is pointed at, and no export can carry a credential.

config.script:
box = lambda n: self.getSibling(n).props.text
	self.view.custom.busy = 'creating the connection...'
	try:
		self.view.custom.busy = AlarmDemo.setup.createDatabase(
			self.view.custom.dbName, box('Host'), box('Port'),
			box('Database'), box('User'), box('Pass'))
		self.getSibling('Pass').props.text = ''
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.busy = 'could not create it: %s' % e
	self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1

props.text: Everything else the demo needs, created by the project on the gateway it was imported onto. Safe to press twice - each item is only created if it is missing.

config.script:
self.view.custom.busy = 'working - this takes about a minute'
	r = AlarmDemo.setup.run()
	done = r.get('changed', [])
	errs = r.get('errors', [])
	if errs:
		self.view.custom.busy = 'finished with problems: ' + '; '.join(errs)
	elif done:
		self.view.custom.busy = '; '.join(done)
	else:
		self.view.custom.busy = 'nothing to do - this gateway was already set up'
	self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1

self.view.custom.busy = 'rebuilding history...'
	n = AlarmDemo.backfill.run(days=30, perDay=85)
	self.view.custom.busy = 'history rebuilt: %d journal rows' %% n
	self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1

item = self.view.custom.state['items'][0]
	self.view.custom.busy = 'creating %s...' % item['title']

		self.view.custom.busy = AlarmDemo.setup.fix(item['key'])
	except Exception, e:
		self.view.custom.busy = 'failed: %s' % e
	self.view.custom.tick = self.view.custom.tick + 1
